services.name: The Art of Goodbye Exhibit Opening
services.desc: Explore the ways in which mourning and death rituals have evolved through the Colonial, Victorian and Modern eras. We will be exhibiting a range of artifacts from local gravestone rubbings, hair jewelry and mourning attire to items from the McCoy Funeral Home private collection. If you are a museum member, you may join us at 4:30 for a cocktail hour featuring spooky seasonal drinks hosted by JH Bards. If you would like to become a member any time before this special event, please visit our Membership Page. This year, we have some special guests appearing on the opening night! services.desc: The Blacksburg Museum & Cultural Foundation offers a variety of options for your event needs. Combining the elegance of Victorian architecture with the convenience of modern amenities, it is the ideal location for receptions, dinners, presentations, corporate meetings, seminars, small to medium weddings and/or receptions, and reunions. We also provide discounts on rentals at certain membership levels. blurb: The St. Luke & Odd Fellows Hall is the last remaining building in what was New Town, a neighborhood that grew amid a racially divided climate. Its early residents did not have the same necessary resources as Blacksburg’s white population.
